why_not_pushed: Not pushed. build/publish_vaults.py creates the vault and writes the vault id and the PUBLIC READ KEY here; the vault key is write access and is written nowhere, ever.

licence.name: World News Day 2026: the corpus described
licence.description: Twenty-one commissioned op-eds published for World News Day 2026, fetched, frozen, hashed, described, classified by a published lexicon and expressed as a typed graph. The description is ours; the op-eds are not.
licence.copyrightNotice: CC BY 4.0 covers the description, the counts, the graph, the lexicon, the transcription and the code in this bundle. It does NOT cover the twenty-one op-eds under sources/frozen/, which are the work of their authors, published at worldnewsday.org, and carried here as frozen evidence under the terms their own pages state.

read_key_note: A read key is derived one-way from the vault key and grants read and only read. The vault key is write access to everything and is published nowhere, in any file, ever.
